title: sorbus aria var. buekkensis
intro: Sorbus aria var. buekkensis, commonly known as Buek's whitebeam, is a rare and lesser-known variety of the whitebeam tree (Sorbus aria) native to Hungary. The plant has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues, and its health benefits include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Sorbus aria var. buekkensis include reducing inflammation, soothing digestive issues, and supporting immune function. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
